lines.beaver_en: Hello! I'm Kim Minjun. Today's my first day.
lines.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Park Sujin. I look forward to working with you.

lines.beaver_en: Are there many staff in the office?
lines.learner: 네, 오십 명쯤 있어요. 사무실이 커서 좋아요.
lines.en: Yes, about fifty. The office is big, so it's nice.
lines.roman: Ne, osip myeongjjeum isseoyo. Samusiri keoseo joayo.

lines.beaver_en: What time do we start work?
lines.learner: 아홉 시에 와요. 일은 여섯 시에 끝나요.
lines.en: We come at nine. Work ends at six.
lines.roman: Ahop sie wayo. Ireun yeoseot sie kkeunnayo.

lines.beaver_en: So we leave work at six?
lines.learner: 네, 그런데 일이 많아서 늦게 퇴근할 때도 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, but sometimes we leave late because there's a lot of work.
lines.roman: Ne, geureonde iri manaseo neutge toegeunhal ttaedo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How long is the lunch break?
lines.learner: 한 시간이에요. 열두 시부터 한 시까지예요.
lines.en: One hour. From twelve to one.
lines.roman: Han siganieyo. Yeoldu sibuteo han sikkajiyeyo.

lines.learner: 보통 여름에 가요. 휴가는 인사팀에 말해요.
lines.en: Usually in summer. Tell the HR team about your leave.
lines.roman: Botong yeoreume gayo. Hyuganeun insatime malhaeyo.

lines.learner: 삼 층에 있어요. 제가 내일 같이 가 줄게요.
lines.en: On the third floor. I'll go with you tomorrow.
lines.roman: Sam cheunge isseoyo. Jega naeil gachi ga julgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you. I'm a bit nervous since it's my first time.
lines.learner: 괜찮아요. 저도 처음에 일이 어려워서 힘들었어요.
lines.en: It's okay. The work was hard for me at first too.
lines.roman: Gwaenchanayo. Jeodo cheoeume iri eoryeowoseo himdeureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How is life at the company?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 우리 회사는 사람들이 친절해서 좋아요.
lines.en: It's good. Our company is great because people are kind.
lines.roman: Joayo. Uri hoesaneun saramdeuri chinjeolhaeseo joayo.

lines.beaver_en: What a relief. I learned a lot today. Thanks.
lines.learner: 천만에요. 그럼 내일 아침에 사무실에서 만나요.
lines.en: You're welcome. See you in the office tomorrow morning.
lines.roman: Cheonmaneyo. Geureom naeil achime samusireseo mannayo.
